prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Predictions were mostly too high compared to actual noise-corrected results, except for sign_in notification where the prediction was too low.
No effect was seen for home new_flow changes across 2 tests.
No effect was seen for sign_in reorder changes across 2 tests.
No effect was seen for adoption redesign across 2 tests, while another 2 tests made adoption worse.
No effect was seen for finish new_screen in 1 test, while 1 test made finish worse.
Evidence is still thin for adoption new_flow, choose_path reorder, and sign_in notification, as each has only 1 test.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, new_flow: -5.7% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- adoption, redesign: -3.8% after noise correction, 4 test(s)
- choose_path, reorder: +0.8% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- finish, new_screen: -1.7% after noise correction, 2 test(s)
- home, new_flow: -2.1% after noise correction, 2 test(s)
- sign_in, notification: +8.0% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- sign_in, reorder: -1.2% after noise correction, 2 test(s)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 79.3%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 60.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 19.4%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [choose_path, new_screen] Path Selection Orientation Screen: Inserts an orientation preview screen before choose_path that highlights what adoption paths offer. (why: choose_path has a mean duration of 514s, showing users hesitate before selecting a path.)
1: [sign_in, notification] Sign In Session Sync Notification: Triggers a notification during sign-in informing users that logging in locks their pet data to their account. (why: 8 support emails reported pets missing or reset after signing back in.)
2: [sign_in, hint] Sign In Cloud Backup Hint: Displays a hint text under sign-in options explaining that signing in prevents pet loss. (why: 8 user complaints focused on reset or missing pets after sign-in.)
3: [adoption, new_flow] Pet Matchmaker Guided Selection Flow: Adds a guided quick matchmaker quiz screen right before pick_friend to help users pick a pet based on play style. (why: Adoption conversion drops to 60.9% with a median time of 89s.)
4: [adoption, layout] Upload Photos Structured Checklist Layout: Changes the upload photos screen layout to checklist format to guide clear photo requirements. (why: 3 support tickets noted custom pet generation failing or looking wrong, and adoption drops to 60.9%.)
5: [home, wait_info] Waiting Screen Completion Time Estimate Info: Adds a progress bar and remaining time estimate to the waiting screen while generation runs. (why: Home step median time is 201s with a mean of 2336s, indicating long unguided waits.)
6: [home, new_screen] Generation Progress Mascot Showcase Screen: Inserts an interactive mascot preview screen during pet generation to teach basic desktop interactions. (why: Users take up to 2336s on home wait step and 3 support tickets reported confusion over controlling pets.)
7: [finish, redesign] Home Intro Split View Desktop Guide Redesign: Redesigns the final home intro screen into a split layout with explicit desktop controls on the right. (why: Finish step drops to 64.8% and support received multiple queries on how to control or hide pets post-setup.)
8: [finish, hint] Desktop Taskbar Control Hint: Adds a hint on the finish screen explaining how to access the pet options menu in the system tray. (why: 3 support tickets reported users being confused about how to hide, control, or talk to the pet.)
